slots.name: seats needed
slots.sentence: To capture the Senate majority, Democrats need to gain four seats and defend every seat they currently control, which includes New Hampshire.

slots.name: election margin
slots.sentence: Pappas, who has represented the 1st Congressional District since 2019 and is the first openly gay member of Congress from New Hampshire, is facing off in a primary on Tuesday against Karishma Manzur, a member of the Democratic Socialists of America.

slots.name: 2024 vote margin
slots.sentence: Trump lost the Granite State by just 3 points in 2024, giving Republicans hope about making this open-seat race competitive two years later.

slots.name: Republican candidates
slots.sentence: Two of the eight Republicans hoping to replace the three-term Democrat are former U.S. senators she previously defeated: John E. Sununu and Scott Brown.

slots.name: Democratic candidates
slots.sentence: The five-way race for the Democratic nomination includes U.S. Rep. Chris Pappas, whose departure from his 1st Congressional District seat in turn attracted a crowd of candidates.

slots.name: Republican Senate win gap
slots.sentence: Republicans haven't won a Senate election in New Hampshire in 16 years, but they view the open Democrat-held seat as a top flip opportunity in the fight to hold their slim majority in the midterm elections.

slots.name: Sununu endorsements
slots.sentence: Brown charged in a Fox News Digital interview that Sununu's "got 70 endorsements on his website, but he doesn't have the president’s. He never talks about it. He's embarrassed by it."

slots.name: Manzur wage proposal
slots.sentence: The first-time candidate, scientist with a Ph.D. in biochemistry and nonprofit leader who is a member of a local Democratic Socialists of America (DSA) group, is pushing for universal healthcare, raising the minimum wage to at least $20 per hour, abolishing ICE and ending all military aid to Israel for what she argues is the Israeli government's "genocide" against the Palestinian people in their war against Hamas in Gaza.

slots.name: House service
slots.sentence: Sununu, who spent six years in the U.S. House and one term in the Senate before being ousted by Shaheen in 2008, has this time focused on themes including affordability for housing, healthcare and energy, holding Congress accountable and constituent service.
